scripts.build:wasm: bash -c 'RUST_SRC="${RUST_SRC_PATH%/*}"; if [ -z "$RUST_SRC" ]; then RUST_SRC="$(rustc --print sysroot)/lib/rustlib/src/rust"; fi; if [ ! -f "$RUST_SRC/Cargo.lock" ] && [ ! -f "$RUST_SRC/library/Cargo.lock" ]; then rm -rf .rust-src && cp -rL "$RUST_SRC" .rust-src && chmod -R u+w .rust-src && touch .rust-src/Cargo.lock .rust-src/library/Cargo.lock && export RUST_SRC_PATH="$(pwd)/.rust-src/library"; fi; cargo build -p surfer-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -Z build-std=std,panic_abort --release && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/surfer_wasm.wasm --out-dir src/lib/client/wasm --target web'
scripts.watch:wasm: nodemon --watch surfer-core/src --watch surfer-wasm/src --ext rs --exec "bun run build:wasm"
scripts.dev: bun run build:wasm && concurrently "vite" "bun run --watch src/server/index.ts" "bun run watch:wasm"
scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && tsc && vite build
scripts.test:all: bun run test:rust:parallel && bun test:server && bun test:e2e && bun run test:unit
